content.prompt:
The two events $A$ and $B$ are known to be independent.
Find the value of $x$ by setting up and solving the equation:

spec.description: Two horizontally overlapping circles inside a rectangular universal set; A is left and B right.

spec.answerVisibility: All region labels are permanent question givens.
